messages:
Jordan: Heads up — GCP Marketplace PO stuck in approval queue. Procurement flagged it as 'billing entity mismatch / missing EIN'. Partner says PO# 2026-8715 was submitted yesterday and is needed for next-week launch. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRT-4123

Neha: Can you paste the PO payload or a screenshot? I want to see what fields we're missing.

Jordan: Pasted snippet below (partner redacted some fields):
```
PO#: 2026-8715
vendor: NovaEdge Inc
billing_entity: "NovaEdge US"
ein: ""
amount: $48,000
marketplace_id: gcp-market-011
```

Tom: Looks like a reseller alias issue — GCP portal occasionally drops EINs for channel partners. We can map vendor->billing entity in our ledger as a temporary fix, but finance needs to sign off. If Legal allows a provisional acceptance clause, ops can issue a provisional invoice.

Eva: @Tom @Jordan I also saw contract redlines on this account: partner added an export-control carveout and wants a higher indemnity cap. Legal can't approve manual invoicing if material MSA terms are unsettled. Please share the contract link.

Liam: Looping in @Carmen (partner success) — partner is pushing for go-live. Carmen, any chance they can reissue the PO with EIN, or accept a LOI? :pray:

Carmen: Partner ops said they can re-issue but their portal requires a new PO file; they'll try to push it through in 24-48h. Their PM suggested a "letter of intent" as a stopgap to authorize provisioning.

Neha: Action items — 1) Finance: approve temporary ledger alias for PO 2026-8715 (Tom to open ticket). 2) Legal: triage MSA redline and confirm if an addendum is acceptable (Eva). 3) Partner success: confirm re-issued PO ETA and LOI option (Carmen). 4) Partnerships/Marketplace ops: escalate to GCP if portal continues stripping EINs (Jordan).

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice pipeline check: PO 2026-8715 — status: queued -> procurement_review (since 2026-03-11T13:22Z).

Tom: I've opened FIN-7890 to request alias approval. If approved we'll produce a provisional invoice labeled: "Bill to: NovaEdge US (EIN pending)" and proceed with provisioning.

Eva: I'll review the MSA redlines tonight, ETA EOD PT. If it's just indemnity cap/export carveout we may be able to accept via addendum.

Jordan: Thanks everyone. Please update the JIRA tickets instead of DMs so ops/finance/legal have an auditable trail. I'll tag updates in PRT-4123. If finance approves the provisional invoice, partner success can accept it and we keep the launch window.

Neha: Noted — I'll monitor FIN-7890 and PRT-4123 and ping here when there's movement. :eyes:
